== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The dated June 2003 revision defines the forfeit of characters hit by permanent weapons as printed forfeit minus 3, replacing the original wording which also barred modification. The December remaster retains the June formula, removes the 2-Force Shield play cost, and specifies five outside cards. The 19 June label belongs to the publisher’s download index. The August and February supplements confirm the June wording under Clarification.
